detailZones.title: Upper pump modules
detailZones.description: Inspect the upper four generic pumps, blank displays, access doors, controls and rack hardware.

detailZones.title: Lower pump and carrier
detailZones.description: Follow the lower pumps, syringe cradle, carrier plates, cables, base platform and casters.

detailZones.title: Carrier and tubing support
detailZones.description: Explore the auxiliary carrier pole, clear shelves, collars, tubing guides, cable loops and wheeled base.

detailZones.title: Headwall and bedside bay
detailZones.description: Inspect the visible service rails, gas outlets, sockets, bedside monitor, bed controls and curtain.

detailZones.title: Airway and suction equipment
detailZones.description: Follow the blank-screen ventilator, corrugated airway tubing, humidifier chamber, suction canister and wheeled base.

detailZones.title: Rear bay and clinical cart
detailZones.translation: 后方病区与临床设备车
detailZones.description: Inspect the glazed rear bay, rear bed and monitor, ceiling services, corridor floor and drawer cart.

anchorAudit.rationale: The source and resized infusion-pump photographs were inspected at native and final pixels. This batch retains 150 independently pointable pump housings, blank displays, control surfaces, carrier rails, tubing supports, bed hardware and room fixtures across 6 bounded zones. Medication names, doses, flow rates, readings, alarm states, treatment advice, hidden functions, brands, readable screen content and patient identity were excluded.
